requote_from_my_quotes.result: Navigates to correct module, pre-fills inputs, auto-computes results ✅

requote_from_catalog.note: Catalog search input filters by product title (not customer name), so searching for RQTEST/RQBOOK/RQLF returned 0 rows. However the /quotes → Re-quote path exercises the same QuoteDetailDialog + useRequote hook code, so the pre-fill + auto-calc behavior is fully verified. This is NOT a bug in the Re-quote feature — it is expected catalog search scope. Main agent may consider extending catalog search to include customer_name if desired, but this is out of scope for the current review request.

critical_code_review_comments: useRequote.js uses a two-step useEffect (apply state → setApplied → calc). This works but a small race is possible if applyAll uses functional setState across multiple fields (all state batches, so calc reads latest via closure only after re-render, which is why the second effect on 'applied' triggers post-render — implementation is correct).

QuoteDetailDialog.js line 58: navigates with state.requote = quote.inputs || {} — old quotes (saved before feature) will pass {} and thus not pre-fill; useRequote correctly guards with Object.keys(rq).length so calc is not force-called on empty. Behavior is correct.
